w5.trans_en: I’m sorry I can’t come to the wedding.
w5.point_en: 残 is ザン on-yomi (残業・残念) and のこ-る kun. 念 is ネン.
why_en: だんねん is 断念 (give up) — different kanji.

w5.trans_en: I’m going to take a picture — smile.
w5.point_en: 笑 is わら-う. The distractors are て-forms of 洗・祝・払, same rhythm, only the first mora differs.

w5.trans_en: Please move the car over there.
w5.point_en: 移 is イ (移動) and うつ-る／うつ-す.
why_en: じどう = 自動／児童 (automatic / child).

w5.trans_en: Sorry my reply is late.
w5.point_en: 遅 has two kun with different meanings: おそ-い (slow) and おく-れる (later than planned).
why_en: あきれて = 呆れて (be appalled).

w5.trans_en: I hear Yamada quit the company.
w5.point_en: 辞める is resigning or leaving (会社を辞める). Just stopping an action is やめる／止める.
why_en: なめた = licked / looked down on.

w5.trans_en: Tie your shoelaces.
w5.point_en: 結 is ケツ (結局・結構) and むす-ぶ — tying a cord or a relationship.
why_en: もすぶ is not a real reading.
みすぶ is not a real reading.
ゆすぶ is 揺すぶる — different kanji.

w5.trans_en: Grandfather lives deep in the mountains.
w5.point_en: 奥 is おく, the inner / deep part. 奥さん uses the same character.
why_en: そく is not a reading of 奥.
ろく is not a reading of 奥.
まく is not a reading of 奥.

w5.trans_en: Politics is a hard topic.
w5.point_en: 治 has ジ and チ: 政治 (せいじ), 治療 (ちりょう). Here it’s ジ.
why_en: せいち = 治 misread as チ.
しょうじ = 障子 (sliding paper door).

w5.trans_en: A letter came from our son.
w5.point_en: 息子（むすこ） is a jukujikun; you can’t split it as 息（いき）. Daughter is 娘（むすめ）.
why_en: むつこ is not this word.
もすこ is not this word.
もつこ is not this word.

w5.trans_en: Japanese sake is made from rice.
w5.point_en: 酒 is シュ (日本酒) and さけ (お酒); in compounds it becomes さか (酒屋・酒場).
why_en: ちょ is not an on-yomi of 酒.
ちゅ is not an on-yomi of 酒.
じゅ is not an on-yomi of 酒.

w5.trans_en: I wrote a thank-you postcard.
w5.point_en: 礼 is レイ, thanks: お礼を言う. The shape is close to 札 — only the right side differs.

w5.trans_en: When would be convenient for me to visit?
w5.point_en: 伺う is the humble form of 聞く・行く・訪ねる. The four options share a left side; look at the right.
why_en: 司 = つかさど-る (司会, preside).

w5.trans_en: Look up the meaning of the word.
w5.point_en: 調 is チョウ (調子・強調) and しら-べる. All four end in 〜べる; only the kanji tells them apart.

w5.trans_en: Wipe the sweat with a towel.
w5.point_en: Sweat, juice, and tears (汗・汁・涙) all have the water radical. 汗をかく is a set phrase.

w5.trans_en: First chop the ingredients finely.
w5.point_en: 最 means “most”: 最初・最後・最近. 再 and 際 also read サイ — split them by meaning.
why_en: 際 = when / at the time of.

w5.trans_en: The weather is getting better.
w5.point_en: All four read フク; only radical and meaning split 回復・服・幸福・空腹.

w5.trans_en: Thank you for your kindness last year.
w5.point_en: 昨年 is the formal 去年, common at year-end. Same family as 昨日・昨夜.
why_en: 次年 = the following year — wrong for this greeting.
各年 is not a usual word.

w5.trans_en: I won’t go back to the office; I’ll go straight home.
w5.point_en: 直接 = with no stop in between. “Not going back to the office” is the hint.
why_en: 真 = 真剣・真っ黒 (serious / pitch-black).

w5.trans_en: Buy headache medicine.
w5.point_en: The noun is 頭痛（ずつう）; the adjective phrase is 頭が痛い. 通 also reads ツウ.

w5.trans_en: I have no appetite.
w5.point_en: 欲 is ヨク (食欲・意欲) and ほ-しい.
why_en: 色 = color; 食色 is not a Japanese word.
気 — 食気 is not a common word.

w6.trans_en: It should be sunny across the country this weekend.
w6.point_en: 晴 is セイ (晴天) and は-れる. The four options differ only in the first mora.
why_en: ばれる = be found out — different kanji.
てれる = 照れる (be shy).
なれる = 慣れる (get used to).

w6.trans_en: This is a food sold widely in Japan.
w6.point_en: 般 is ハン; after 一 it becomes いっ**ぱん** by sokuon + half-voicing. Same pattern as 一方（いっぽう）.
why_en: いっせん = 一線 (a line).
いっそう = 一層 (even more).
いっせい = 一斉 (all at once).

w6.trans_en: What fruit is this?
w6.point_en: 果物（くだもの） is jukujikun, not 果 split as カ. Don’t mix with 獣（けだもの） — one mora off.
why_en: こだもの is not a reading.
こなもの = 粉物 (flour dishes).

w6.trans_en: Our team played a strong team and won.
w6.point_en: 戦 is セン (戦争・作戦) and たたか-う. The distractors scramble the same kana.
why_en: かたかって — kana order wrong.
たかたって — kana order wrong.
かかたって — kana order wrong.

w6.trans_en: Attend an international conference.
w6.point_en: Two traps: 際 is サイ (not セイ); 議 is ギ (会議・議論).
why_en: こくせいかいに — both 際 and 議 wrong.
こくさいかいに — 議 misread.
こくせいかいぎ — 際 misread as せい.

w6.trans_en: I study politics and economics at university.
w6.point_en: 治 in 政治 is ジ (治療 is チ). 済 in 経済 is ザイ, not サイ. Q10 tests the kun す-む.
why_en: せいちけいざい — 治 as チ.
せいちけいさい — both wrong.
せいじけいさい — 済 as さい.

w6.trans_en: Don’t lose to the cold — keep going.
w6.point_en: 負 is フ (負担) and ま-ける / お-う. Option 3 怠ける also makes sense, but it is not 負.
why_en: なさけないで = 情けない (pathetic).
もけないで is not a reading.
なまけないで = 怠けないで (don’t slack off).
まけないで = don’t lose. Correct.

w6.trans_en: Import raw materials.
w6.point_en: All four are 〜料. 原 is ゲン: 原料・原因.
why_en: げんりょう = raw materials. Correct.
こうりょう = 香料 (spice / perfume).

w6.trans_en: Please don’t throw trash out the car window.
w6.point_en: Compound of 投げる + 捨てる. 投 also has トウ (投票).
why_en: まげすて = 曲げ — different kanji.

w6.trans_en: Finish your homework before you watch TV.
w6.point_en: 済 is サイ (経済) and す-む／す-ませる. Q6 is the on-yomi of the same character.
why_en: からませて = 絡ませて (entangle).
さませて = 冷ませて／覚ませて (cool / wake).
おわませて is not a word.

w6.trans_en: Report the experiment results.
w6.point_en: Close readings: 実験 has a sokuon; 事件（じけん） does not.
why_en: 事件 = じけん — missing the sokuon, different meaning.

w6.trans_en: Ask a specialist for an opinion.
w6.point_en: 専門 uses 門 (gate), not 問 (ask) — a famous mix-up.
why_en: 専問家 = 門 written as 問.
千聞家 is not a word.
千文家 is not a word.

w6.trans_en: Discuss global warming.
w6.point_en: 温 and 暖 share あたた-かい. Weather uses 暖; water and feeling use 温. 温暖化 needs both.
why_en: 温段化 = 暖 written as 段.
音暖化 = 温 written as 音.

w6.trans_en: A north wind will blow tomorrow, so it will get cold.
w6.point_en: 吹 is ふ-く for wind and instruments. Same reading as 拭く (wipe).
why_en: 比いて is not a word.

w6.trans_en: The next test covers up through Lesson 10.
w6.point_en: Textbook lessons use 課: 第1課. Don’t mix with 部, 問, or 科.

w6.trans_en: The factory was mechanized.
w6.point_en: Suffix 〜化 means “turn into”: 機械化・温暖化・国際化. Same as Q13.
why_en: 比 = compare — not a suffix here.
的 makes a na-adjective (個人的), not “become.”

w6.trans_en: I quit for personal reasons.
w6.point_en: Suffix 〜的 makes a na-adjective: 個人的な. Pair it with Q16’s 〜化.
why_en: 上 = from the standpoint of (仕事上).
因 = cause, not a suffix here.

w6.trans_en: Listen to the weather forecast on the radio.
w6.point_en: All four are 予〜. Weather takes 予報. 予想 is your own guess; 予報 is issued.
why_en: 予想 = guess — not the set phrase for weather.

w6.trans_en: The prime minister denied the news report.
w6.point_en: 否 (ヒ) is negation: 否定・拒否. Opposite is 肯定.
why_en: 無定 is not a word.
正定 is not a word.

w6.trans_en: The person on the phone seems to be somewhere with no signal.
w6.point_en: 電波が届く／届かない is the set phrase for mobile signal. 波 is ハ, voiced after 電 as でん**ぱ**.
